text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Parcae... understands me. They take<n>the data I input
and guide me to the<n>correct answer. Adhering only
to truth,<n>they do what I want them to and do it<n>well.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As long as I give them the right input,<n>the output is
absolute. The perfect,<n>all-encompassing,
well-defined<n>equation.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: But because of that... Parcae can'tunderstand me. In their world of onesand zeros, the process of despairsimply doesn't exist.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm on the lookout for a racer to<n>scout, so I stop by
practice. There, a<n>number of Umamusume who
haven't<n>made their debuts yet gather to train.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O and Top Road are both so<n>cool... I may
never catch up, but... I<n>have to try!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the prestigious Tracen<n>Academy, all
the students have<n>promise. As I watch them
excitedly, I<n>notice something out of the corner of<n>my
eye...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Beside me is an Umamusume<n>observing the
runners on the track.<n>Her serious gaze occasionally
shifts<n>to her laptop, where she seems to be<n>typing
something.
choice_data_list: (What an intense stare. It's almost like...)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her gaze isn't fixed on the racers in<n>front of her, or
even her laptop<n>screen... They seem to be
searching<n>for something... desperately so.
...Tch!
Hmph...
choice_data_list: (Ah, I shouldn't have been staring like that.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see that? Air Shakur<n>seriously freaks
me out. I can't<n>believe she glared at an adult like
that...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
But isn't she, like, a genius or<n>something? Even
Teach said she's<n>got the brains and skills... It's
just<n>the way she does things that's off.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she's always out till just<n>before
curfew. I bet she's up to no<n>good... Maybe that's
why she's so<n>prickly... I don't know what goes on
in her head.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur... It looks like she's got<n>quite the
fearsome reputation, and<n>perhaps rightfully so. That
uniquely<n>fierce stare left quite the impression<n>on me.

Like. I. Said. I'm not doing anything,<n>so what's the
big deal?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That night, as I'm returning to the<n>school from a
quick trip into town, I<n>spot an Umamusume being
stopped<n>by the police.

Every damn time, you stop me. And<n>for what? It's
not even that late... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text: Hm? You there... Do you know this<n>girl?

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text:
So you're from the academy... Good.<n>I'll hand you
over to your teacher<n>now. No more wandering
around so<n>late at night, got it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Hand me over"? Way to treat me like<n>a criminal.
And based on nothing but<n>assumptions at that.

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text:
That's not it! You're always in those<n>net cafes till
late. I'm just worried<n>you'll get wrapped up in
something<n>bad... You're so stubborn!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Something tells me that unless I say<n>something,
these two will just keep<n>bickering...
choice_data_list:
Sorry, I was the one who told her to wait there for
me.

Sorry, I was the one who told her to wait there for
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text:
...If that's the case, fine. However,<n>you shouldn't
leave minors<n>unattended for so long. As for you, if
you're waiting for your teacher, just<n>say so!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I take Air Shakur back to the dorms<n>after bidding
the policeman good<n>night. She doesn't say a word
to me<n>the entire way back...
choice_data_list: Make sure you're not out too late, okay?
Make sure you're not out too late, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...That all you're gonna say? I was<n>out till curfew,
and I know my<n>reputation around school's not
great.<n>It's obvious you'd be suspicious.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Lemme guess, you just don't want<n>to deal with
this crap, right? In that<n>case, I wholeheartedly
agree.
choice_data_list: I just figured you had a good reason to be out late.
I just figured you had a good reason to be out late.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...What?
choice_data_list: You just seem... serious about racing.
You just seem... serious about racing.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The way she looked this afternoon<n>tells me
everything I need to know. I<n>can't imagine anyone
with that stern<n>gaze doing something that could
jeopardize her career.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Instead... I imagine she was simply<n>looking for
somewhere she can<n>concentrate in order to
continue her<n>work, whatever it is.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So you're not even going to<n>investigate further?
You're just<n>letting me go because of baseless
impressions and feelings... You're no<n>better than
that cop.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ultimately, everyone just sees what<n>they want to
see—mixing desires into<n>decisions... and your minds
suffer for<n>it. That’s why I chase the truth...<n>You're
unreliable, unlike my partner.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... My PC. But they're more than<n>just a
machine, okay? They're like<n>another brain—a
partner capable of<n>giving me all the answers.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Based on all the data I collect, they<n>can give me the
most efficient<n>regimen, a surefire strategy for
scrimmages... and whatever else I<n>need.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
As long as I don't mess up during<n>data entry,
they'll spit out the right<n>answer. And they give it to
me<n>straight too, none of that vague crap.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But Parcae can only help those who<n>want to help
themselves. That's why<n>we work so well. I’m
more than<n>willing to follow the path they set for<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah, no duh. I made them myself<n>after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Gross much?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I've upset her once<n>again... So I decide
to head back to my<n>room, reminding myself to mind
my<n>words and actions going forward.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Shakur! You're finally baaack!<n>U-um, uh... Are
you... Um, weeell...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I was organizing some of my data.<n>It's just
easier to concentrate at a<n>cafe than here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And I thought I told you, you don't<n>have to wait up
for me. The entire<n>reason I leave is so you...
Whatever,<n>let's just sleep. We've gotta be up
early.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Okayyy... Um, that reminds me...<n>Shakur, a trainer is
going to observe<n>your training tomorrow, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
They want to see what I can do. I<n>mean, I'll run,
but... I know it's going<n>to end the same as always.
It's not<n>even worth running a simulation.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Either way, it doesn't concern you.<n>I'm turning off
the light.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it. The answer didn't change.<n>C’ｍon,
Parcae...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Parcae... You were born of my<n>obsession with the
Twinkle Series.<n>Everything from your OS to the
applications you use—I made you<n>myself.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Based on your analysis, I should be<n>debuting soon.
My physical condition<n>is improving as predicted.
However...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (That number hasn't changed. Whichmakes sense, since the code is right.That number is absolute.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(So why do I... keep redoing it?<n>Analysis?
Verification? Desperation?<n>What is it...)
